paragraphs: He is mentioned favorably in Mishnah Yoma 3:10: he made twelve spouts for the laver, and a mechanism for it.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source prints לשכח, read as לשבח, “favorably.”

The Torat Emet digital text of Mishnah Yoma 3:10 explicitly gives Ben Katin’s twelve spouts and mechanism for the laver. The supplied לשכח remains unchanged; the favorable rendering and existing note are retained. No other figures, praise attribution, mechanism details, or printed-source correction history are imported from the longer paragraph.
